name: What causes mold to grow on ceilings?

mainEntity.name: What causes mold to grow on ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold on ceilings is typically caused by excess moisture. Common culprits include roof leaks, plumbing leaks from upstairs bathrooms or pipes in the attic, condensation due to poor ventilation, or high indoor humidity. When moisture collects on a surface and isn't dried quickly, mold spores, which are naturally present in the air, find a suitable environment to grow and spread.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold on ceilings is usually caused by excess moisture from leaks or high humidity. Undried moisture allows mold spores to grow.
